plainText:
Kana Ueda (Japanese: 植田佳奈 Ueda Kana) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Ueda was born on June 9, 1980, in , , and raised in . As an adult, she attended Kobe College and graduated from its General Culture department. She later became a voice actress and eventually became well-known for a number of roles in anime series. Ueda voiced a character of the day, Luna, during . She then voiced her best-known role in , Mistralton City Gym Leader Skyla. Ueda is affiliated with the voice talent management firm .
